photos.alt: The roofs and courtyards of the Forbidden City seen from Jingshan Park.
A bronze guardian lion in front of a red-walled hall in the Forbidden City.
A bronze tortoise on a stone pedestal among the palace courtyards.
Layered palace roofs and red walls beneath a cloudy sky in the Forbidden City.
A gilded guardian figure beside a decorated gateway in the Forbidden City.
Sahaj beside the moat, with an illuminated corner tower of the Forbidden City reflected in the water.
Sahaj looking along the Great Wall as it winds over green mountain ridges at Mutianyu.
The Great Wall climbing a wooded hillside between watchtowers at Mutianyu.
A steep stone staircase leading up to a watchtower on the Great Wall.
The wall and distant mountain ridges framed by stone battlements and branches.
Sahaj looking out from a cable car over the hills at Mutianyu.
Sahaj in front of Beijing’s Bird’s Nest stadium, its steel lattice glowing orange and red at night.
The petal-shaped exterior of the Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre Tennis Centre.
Asian Games mascots beside the lotus-shaped venue and gardens in Hangzhou.
Illuminated Asian Games decorations and mascots in the Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre area at night.
Sahaj standing beside a lakeside pavilion at West Lake in Hangzhou.
A pavilion beside West Lake, framed by willow branches and broad lotus leaves.
The illuminated Pudong skyline seen from the Bund, with the Oriental Pearl Tower across the river.
An ornate building facade on the Bund lit in warm colours at night.
Looking up at the illuminated Jin Mao Tower and the Shanghai World Financial Center at night.
The Oriental Pearl Tower glowing pink and orange against the night sky in Lujiazui.
Large tortoises resting together in an enclosure at Shanghai Zoo.
A rock-shaped entrance decorated with red lanterns inside Shanghai Zoo.
A shaded waterside path beneath willow trees in Shanghai Zoo.
Silver fish swimming through a blue-lit aquarium at Shanghai Zoo.
Traditional rooflines glowing with golden lights in the Yuyuan Bazaar area at night.
A traditional pavilion and covered walkway over a koi pond in Yuyuan Garden.
A tall traditional-style building with illuminated signs near Yuyuan Bazaar late at night.
The Enchanted Storybook Castle at Shanghai Disneyland beneath a cloudy sky.
Sahaj posing with an Ant-Man character in front of a large Avengers emblem at Shanghai Disneyland.
A view over the Alice in Wonderland Maze and its oversized Red Queen face at Shanghai Disneyland.
A chocolate-covered Mickey-shaped ice cream held above its wrapper.
A giant Mickey-shaped pumpkin display at Shanghai Disneyland.
A Shanghai Maglev train waiting beside the platform at Longyang Road station.
Wooden boats on a canal in Zhujiajiao, between stone paths, waterside shops, and leafy trees.
